rows.en: Shocker!? What are you talking about? We are the DARK Destruction Squad! Never mind, tear them apart!!
A new enemy!? Be careful, [HERO4]!
Roger!!
Insolent fools… Do you think mere humans can beat me!?
[HERO4], did you really hear it?

Yeah, I really did! It's a really nasty sound. It sounded kind of like a flute…

The person playing it must be really bad at it, huh? With that, even electronic instruments are gonna go haywire. It's straight-up noise pollution, seriously…

Oh… Looks like there's someone else who got sick from it…
A new enemy!? Be careful, [HERO4]!
Is it that guy? The one playing the flute… Super annoying.
Ngh, s-strong… We'll settle this another time!
So… how's that young man doing?
Well… it seems he isn't human.
What!? Then he's… a cyborg too?

No, unlike us, he's an elaborate android that someone built from scratch.

The mechanism's so complicated that there's no way to work on him without blueprints. He's still shut down, too.

An elaborate android!?

The only one who could build something like that… as far as I know, Dr. Komyoji…? No, it has to be him!

Komyoji? You don't mean Dr. Komyoji, the one famous for robotics?

But hasn't the doctor been missing for several years?
Hmm… Something smells fishy! Something, you know… a real whiff of it. And this new enemy bothers me too.
According to the TDF's information, that's an organization called DARK. Apparently the FBI's been after them for several years too…

I see…

Even so, I wish we could do something for him. This young man… he's a bit like Goro somehow, isn't he? I just can't think of him as a stranger…

…………

Still, an android carrying a guitar… Hm?
What's wrong, Goro?
There's something inside the guitar? What is it? This is…!? Some kind of blueprint?

A blueprint!?

This is… a blueprint of him! In that case… it's time for that guy to step in.
Hayato… Who's "that guy"?

Heh heh, as long as we have the blueprints… Hongo might be able to repair him.

He's a genius with an IQ of 600, after all. Let's get in touch with him right away!
At his alma mater, Jonan University, Takeshi Hongo repaired Jiro and installed the mechanism for transforming into combat mode.

There, that does it!

How do you feel?
Thank you, Mr. Hongo… I'm all right now.

Yes… It's a really good thing we had your blueprints.

Thanks to them, I was able to find a flaw in part of your combat-mode transformation mechanism.

And one more thing… It's a very rare feature, but it seems you have a Conscience Circuit built in. This is the first time I've seen one actually put into practice.

Unfortunately, though, the blueprints for the Conscience Circuit weren't included in these.

Most likely, they're somewhere else…
It's fine, the way it is now…
Jiro?

To live rightly with an incomplete Conscience Circuit, I was taught three rules by the doctor!

First: A robot must not harm a human being, nor, by overlooking a danger to a human, allow that human to come to harm!

Second: A robot must obey human beings, except where those orders would go against the First Rule.

Third: A robot must protect itself, as long as doing so does not go against the First or Second Rule.

These are what the doctor…
Who's there!?

Heh heh heh…

Dr. Komyoji is in the hands of Grey Rhinoking of the DARK Destruction Squad! If you want to save Komyoji, come to Jigokudani!
Grey Rhinoking! I accept your offer!
All right… We'll help too.
So you've come? Traitor android! DARK will stop at nothing to reach its goal. Die by the landmines along with your friends!
Waaagh!!
Kikaider, jump!
Ha ha ha ha… The android Dr. Komyoji built is nothing special after all!
What's that sound?
Warrior of justice, Kikaider!!

What!? Kikaider?

A warrior of justice? Don't make me laugh! No one who gets in DARK's way will be left alive! Get him!! Do it!
Nngh… Curse you, Kikaider! I'll come back and challenge you again!
Still… new enemies keep turning up one after another like this, don't they?

The DARK Destruction Squad, huh… They're tough opponents, all right! And I'm worried about Dr. Komyoji too.

[HERO2], what do you think we should do?

The DARK Destruction Squad, huh… They're tough opponents, all right! And I'm worried about Dr. Komyoji too.

[HERO2], what do you think we should do?
"Let's leave the doctor to Jiro." "Rescuing Dr. Komyoji comes first."
"Let's leave the doctor to Jiro." "Let's make rescuing Dr. Komyoji our priority."
All right… If that's decided, let's follow after Jiro!
But…

No… Listen, Hongo! Shocker, the Neo-Human Empire, and Makuu too are all still actively on the move.

This may sound harsh, but our fighting strength is limited. Don't forget that…
The DARK Destruction Squad, with its terrifying abilities. The incomplete android Kikaider, Jiro, set off from Hongo and the others in search of his creator, Dr. Komyoji…
Defeat Grey Rhinoking and the Androidmen and rescue Dr. Komyoji!
Defeat Grey Rhinoking and the Androidmen and support Dr. Komyoji!
Defeat Grey Rhinoking to rescue Dr. Komyoji!
Jiro is defeated
Jiro cannot be protected, or all allies are destroyed
What!? Komyoji has escaped?

We're terribly sorry!

We gave him a massive dose of truth serum to make him spill the secret of the special circuit, and he was so dazed that…
So you let your guard down? Fool!!
Ugyaaah!!

Find him!! Find Komyoji!

Kaimen Green of the DARK Destruction Squad! Find Komyoji and bring him back to DARK!
Yes, sir…
The secret of the special circuit must never fall into anyone else's hands! Never! Go!!

I feel as if I've been here before… But it's as though there's a haze over it, and I just can't remember.

That's right! I have definitely been here before! And not just once or twice.
This is Anne. On scheduled patrol in Tokyo's K District… Nothing unusual. Returning to base now.

Look out!!

Are you all right? Are you hurt?

I… I don't know who you are. I don't know why I came here, either.

But I remember… I feel I entrusted something important to you.
Um… Haven't you mistaken me for someone else? I don't know who you are either…
Liar… Now, I'll have it back!
Eeek!
Oh no, DARK's caught up with me!
Hee hee hee… Komyoji, I've found you!

Komyoji?

That's it… This man is that Dr. Komyoji, isn't he? The Dr. Komyoji who's been missing for years.

Now that you, who should have lost your memory, have shown up in this city… a secret must be hidden here!

Out of my way!
Eek, look out! Dr. Komyoji, quick, into the car…
Talk! Where is the secret of the special circuit hidden? You, hand Komyoji over to me!
No, no, that won't do. I may not look it, but I'm an Ultra Garrison officer! I can't abandon a civilian!
What!? So you mean to get in my way?

This is Anne, this is Anne… HQ, please respond!

On patrol in Tokyo's K District… I've found and taken Dr. Komyoji into protection, but we're being attacked by a round green monster.
